Our Story

Artisanal Purity Since 1990

Every sweet, baked confection and dairy product is hand-crafted with pure desi ghee and quality ingredients under strict hygiene standards — a neighbourhood name Landhi has trusted for generations.

  • 100% pure desi ghee in all traditional mithai
  • Fresh daily — dairy churned and sweets prepared every morning
  • Custom cakes for birthdays, weddings & events

Good to Know

Frequently Asked Questions

◆

Everything you need to know before ordering.

Where is Naimat-e-Shireen located in Karachi?
Main Commercial Area, Landhi Town Malir, District Korangi, Karachi. Open daily 08:00 AM – 12:00 midnight for dine-in, takeaway and delivery.
Are the sweets made with pure desi ghee?
Yes — traditional mithai like Gulab Jamun, Motichoor Laddu and Habshi Halwa are prepared in pure desi ghee with fresh milk, without artificial preservatives.
Do you deliver all over Karachi?
Yes, same-day delivery across Karachi including Landhi, Korangi, Malir, DHA, Clifton, Gulshan-e-Iqbal and North Nazimabad. Delivery charges depend on distance — confirm on WhatsApp when ordering.
How can I order online?
Tap the WhatsApp button on any product above, or order through our website at [YOUR-DOMAIN]. For bulk or event orders, message us on WhatsApp at +92 320 5773262.

About Naimat-e-Shireen Sweets & Bakers

Naimat-e-Shireen Sweets & Bakers is a neighbourhood mithai, bakery and dairy shop in Landhi Town Malir, Karachi — serving fresh gulab jamun, motichoor laddu, barfi, jalebi, cakes, desi ghee dairy, savories and gift hampers since 1990. Open daily 08:00 AM to 12:00 midnight at Main Commercial Area, Landhi Town Malir, District Korangi, Karachi.
